signal_contracts.semantics: V1 select key water_box_mode; options from status.water_mode_options, absent when None; ordinal, not volume.
V1 mop route selector; options from status.mop_route_options, absent when None; not cleaning action or ml.
V1 select created only with nonempty cleaning_mode_options. B01/Q7 uses its own mode mapping; do not share enums across protocols.
B01/Q7 select uses CleanPathPreferenceMapping and device clean_path_preference; not a universal V1 key.
V1 sensor uses status.square_meter_clean_area. Whole cleaning area is not proof of exclusively mopped area.
V1 native seconds, suggested minutes; use actual HA unit_of_measurement. Cleaning duration is not proof of active pump time.
